lines.text: Hi, I would like to try the short dance class. Do you have a place this Saturday?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Saturday is full, but we have a place on Sunday at eleven. Are you free then?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: I am free on Sunday morning. Do I need to bring any special shoes?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Clean shoes are fine. Please come ten minutes early so we can show you the room.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: So I should be there at ten fifty. Is the class in the room by the front door?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: It is in the back room, but please come to the front desk first.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Got it. I will bring clean shoes and come to the front desk before eleven.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Great. I will put your name down for Sunday. See you then.
lines.speaker: Eli
